title: DMM6500 Performance Verification

source.document: Keithley Model DMM6500 Calibration and Adjustment Manual (DMM6500-905-01 Rev. E, June 2022)
source.note: ONE interval: 1 year, 18-28 C (ambient within 5 C of TCAL), calculated from the one-year specification without test-equipment uncertainty (p. 2-4). The DMM6500 data sheet is not in the manual set, so the limits cannot be recomputed here.

equipment.calibrator: Fluke 5720A / 5730A (+ 5725A for 750 V above 20 kHz) in the manual; this procedure drives the lab calibrator
equipment.frequency: Keithley 3390 function generator in the manual

general: Warm up the DMM6500 for at least 30 minutes (p. 2-2); 18 to 28 C, relative humidity 80 % or less, no direct airflow on the input terminals.
Restore factory defaults first (MENU > Info/Manage > System Reset, p. 2-6); the program sends *RST and tells the operator.
Do not connect through a scanner or other switching equipment (p. 2-6). Terminals rated CAT II 300 V; 1000 V dc / 750 V ac maximum input; 500 V peak to chassis.

sections.setup: Low-thermal cable, shield to the calibrator output LO (100 mV and 1 V ranges). DMM6500: DC voltage, input impedance Auto. Calibrator at 0 V in operate, allow 5 minutes of thermal settling, enable relative offset on the 100 mV range, then source the full-scale and half-scale values of each range, allowing the reading to settle (p. 2-7, 2-8).

sections.setup: Shielded low-capacitance cable (load below 1000 pF on the 100 mV to 100 V ranges, below 150 pF on 750 V). DMM6500: AC voltage, detector bandwidth 30 Hz (3 Hz for the 20 Hz points, UNVERIFIED choice). The 740 V points: calibrator in standby while connecting (p. 2-13).

sections.setup: DMM6500: Digitize Voltage, sample rate 1000, aperture Auto (1 ms here), count 100. The 5720A / 5730A 1000 V range 0 V setting is not verified (p. 2-15).

sections.title: Simulated thermocouple (type J)
sections.setup: Source values are the NIST Monograph 175 type J voltages (-7.659 mV, 0 mV, 42.281 mV). First measure the cable offset: DMM6500 DC voltage, 100 mV range, input impedance Auto, autozero on, 1 PLC, calibrator at 0 V in operate, wait 5 minutes, record the offset to 1 uV; then DMM6500 Temperature, transducer TC, type J, simulated reference junction 0 degC, 1 PLC, autozero on, and set the calibrator to the table value MINUS the measured offset (p. 2-19, 2-20 step 19).

sections.title: Simulated RTD (PT100)
sections.setup: Calibrator resistance 19, 100 and 190 ohm with EXTERNAL SENSE on (4-wire: INPUT and SENSE to the calibrator; 3-wire: SENSE HI not required, HI-LO lead resistance mismatch below 0.1 ohm, add 0.25 degC per 0.1 ohm). DMM6500: Temperature, transducer 4-wire RTD or 3-wire RTD, RTD type PT100. The expected temperature is the Callendar-Van Dusen value of the ACTUAL source resistance (R0 100, alpha 0.00385055, beta 0.10863, delta 1.4999, ITS-90); limit +/- 0.06 degC (4-wire) or +/- 0.75 degC (3-wire) about it (p. 2-21 to 2-24).
